build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Quick Velocity+Aftertouch Assign 0.1.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version QM11

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f; a fresh card; JIT on; DTBOOT_END_PNG at the end of each run

conditions: SETUP: boot QM11 on a fresh card for 8000M, NO eight times to close the calibration notices, snapshot. Each capture loads that snapshot (the default kit, BD PLASTIC on track 1, SYNTH page) and runs the listed --press and --nudge events, off the --every grid.

captures.plan: --press FIX held, --nudge 1, 2, 3, 0, then 5, three clicks each
--press FIX held, --nudge 1:1 x10; release; FUNC + FLTR, DOWN x2, YES
